title: UPSSSC Forensic Science Laboratory Online Form 2026
organization: Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission
postName: Scientific Assistant & Lab Assistant – Forensic Science Laboratory (Advt. No. 15-Exam/2026)
vacancyDetails: 208 posts: Scientific Assistant (134), Scientific Assistant Special Selection (13), Lab Assistant (56), Lab Assistant Special Selection (05)
qualification: Domain-wise B.Sc. (Biology / Physical Science / Chemistry / Computer Science / Forensic Science) or relevant B.Tech / NIELIT ‘A’ level for Computer Science; PET-2025 with valid non-zero score required
ageLimit: 21 to 40 years as on 01 July 2026 (age relaxation as per UPSSSC rules)
applicationFee: ₹25 for all categories (UR/OBC/EWS/SC/ST/PH) – UPI / Debit / Credit / Net Banking
selectionProcess: Main Examination as per UPSSSC schedule → Document Verification
documentsRequired: Educational certificates, PET-2025 score details, photo ID, passport photos, signature, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit https://upsssc.gov.in
2. Complete OTR / login if required
3. Open Forensic Science Laboratory Main Examination Advt. 15-Exam/2026 apply link
4. Fill form, upload documents, pay ₹25 fee
5. Submit and print application (apply 27 Jul–17 Aug 2026)
shortDescription: UPSSSC Forensic Science Laboratory Online Form 2026 – 208 Scientific Assistant & Lab Assistant posts. Apply 27 July to 17 August 2026 at upsssc.gov.in.
content:
UPSSSC has released the Main Examination notification for Forensic Science Laboratory posts under Advertisement 15-Exam/2026.

Total vacancies: 208 (Scientific Assistant and Lab Assistant, including special selection). Online applications: 27 July 2026 to 17 August 2026. Fee last date: 17 August 2026. Form correction till about 24 August 2026.

Candidates must have appeared in PET-2025 with a valid non-zero score in the relevant domain. Apply only through upsssc.gov.in.
